.qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r9/rules/harbor-webdev-rubric-qc/references/quality-checks.md: section 17 (walk the brief line by line; report each asked-for capability with no implementation)
evidence: Walked instruction.md and the three /instructions notes against the reference. Every asked-for capability has an implementation: sign-in-only shell before auth (index.html:10-23 app hidden; server 401 for all data routes, transcript 401 page server.js:502); walls on list/thread/search/quotes/unread/mentions/link previews/transcript via visibleMatter/visibleMessage (server.js:189-201, 226-235, 320-324, 382-391, 497-505) with partner add/lift UI (index.html:66-73, app.js:248-279, server.js:479-490) and 2 s polling that swaps an open walled matter to 'Not available' (app.js:640-651, 198-211); timers off/1/7/30 with label beside title, partner-only change and immediate sweep on shorten, age >= timer from sent time (server.js:139-147, 467-477, app.js:216); partner-only hold on any message, 'On hold' badge, held messages undeletable, release re-sweeps (server.js:452, 457-465); replies at any depth in seq order with quote and deleted-parent placeholder, same-matter parent enforced (server.js:253-291, 404-411); author edit with 'edited', staff-only versions, 409 stale-edit refusal keeping composer text (server.js:427-444, app.js:474-487, 536-553); confirm-before-delete (app.js:338-345, 495-509); *bold*, `code`, '> ' quotes and http(s) links in new tab on escaped text, raw text in quotes/snippets/versions/transcript (app.js:23-55, 308, 321, 548, 631; server.js:494-517); copyable message links with per-viewer previews and 'not available', /messages/:id opens and highlights until another open (server.js:224-235, app.js:525-533, 583-591, 297); case-insensitive first-name mentions, suggestions limited to people who can see the matter, mention list, edits/deletes update mentions (server.js:209-222, 340-345, 377-381, app.js:427-472); per-user server-side unread with 'New messages' line, read on open, mark unread from any message, deleted excluded (server.js:239-245, 346-360, app.js:186-195, 516-524); Enter/Shift+Enter/Escape (app.js:411-422); idempotent client_key sends and seq ordering (server.js:403-424); live polling that preserves composer, scroll and open versions (app.js:213-239); literal case-insensitive search (server.js:382-391); transcript page with matter number, title, generated time, threads oldest first, author/time/edited/hold, held-edited versions, placeholders, no controls (server.js:497-518); in-place persistent refusals (app.js:355-376, 559-568); 390 px media query (styles.css:118-122); runtime contract: __dirname-relative files, DB_PATH, 0.0.0.0:3000, health 200 even if DB fails, seed once, fixed clock, no shipped app.db (server.js:13-47, 93-128, 156-165, 527-528; solve.sh). Seed copy at solution/app/seed/seed_data.json is byte-identical to environment/assets/seed_data.json. Runtime corroboration: raw-evidence-index hashes match current files, and the scripted golden run on these exact solution bytes (qc/repairs/kittle-2026-10-08/results/functional-before.json/after.json, golden-run.log) records PASS for all 16 functional checks, the constraints gate steps, persistence across a real restart and the six polish checks. This is scripted Playwright evidence, not a configured judge run, Oracle or model score; render/visual were not covered by it. Counterexample probing: a reference lacking the partner wall/timer UI, mention suggestions, stale-edit refusal or transcript would fail this row; none of those is missing. A conforming alternative (e.g. SSE instead of polling, different routes) is not constrained by this row. Minor non-blocking observation: polling refreshes only the matter list and the open matter, so search or mention results fetched before a new wall stay on the search/mentions view until re-run (clicking them returns 'Not available'); the brief's live-wall promise is scoped to someone who 'already has the matter open', which the reference covers.
